targeting.title: Cursor Agent Stuck on "Planning Next Moves"? 8 Checks in Order
targeting.metaTitle: Cursor Agent Stuck on Planning Next Moves? 8 Checks
targeting.metaDescription: Cursor Agent frozen on "Planning next moves" or "Generating"? Eight ordered checks from Cursor staff replies and docs: network path, indexing, MCP, extensions.
targeting.excerpt: Cursor's Agent sitting on "Planning next moves" with no error is usually a dropped streaming connection, unfinished indexing, a broken MCP server, an extension or a build regression. Work through eight checks in the order that resolved the public bug threads, then report with the right data.
